question: Can a permissionless caller of collectProtocolFees(pool) redirect or extract protocol fees to an attacker-controlled address, or break fee accounting via the balanceOf(this) notify amount?
answer: No. The permissionless trigger cannot extract or redirect fees to the caller; all recipients are hardcoded treasury / address(this) / voter-resolved feeDist. The balanceOf quirk causes cross-pool misattribution only on a donation (self-loss), not attacker-profitable theft.
